decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the necessary creative-concept impact: discarding the rejected concept and building its replacement around the first and last reference videos.
Discarding and replacing the script does not change the commissioned video count, duration, commissioning stage, or condition for ordering additional videos.
The source changes script and keyword direction but does not alter the audio-level requirement or resolve its existing ambiguity.
The script replacement and reference-keyword instruction does not decide the visual production method or resolve the live-action versus AI-generated-scenes conflict.

The immediately preceding client message already established a direct, attention-focused hook for the Indian market. Message 51 reinforces the broader script direction and narrows keyword sources without changing those hook attributes.
Rejecting the draft and changing its keyword strategy does not alter the existing winning-creative objective or the below-50-INR cost-per-lead target.
